answer: Require every new identity to enter through a sponsor: a member co-signs an 80 POA bond, locked for 30 days, before the newcomer can earn. The newcomer must pass two audited service rounds, each confirmed on-ledger by four attestors; a failed audit slashes 15 POA from the sponsor's bond. Each sponsor may back at most three identities, and each additional identity needs a bond 1.5 times larger, so fakes cannot multiply from a single vertex without ever more real stake. A network built this way grows like a reef, from sponsors and work, not from a relic of duplicated identities with no history.
